prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original FACELESS WILDCARD human fighter sprite atlas for a cyberpunk pixel-art street-fighting website. Intended role: "bring your own sandbox", an anonymous challenger who can represent any user-submitted sandbox. Do not depict a company mascot or logo.

CHARACTER: adult human of unreadable gender, lean medium build, realistic mature proportions approximately seven heads tall. A charcoal hood shades a completely OPAQUE seamless smoked-black faceplate. The entire face is hidden in EVERY frame and portrait. No visible eyes, mouth, skin, skull, glowing eyes, smiley face, question mark, letters or symbols on mask. Faceplate simple curved dark material with a narrow dull silver rim and small edge reflection. It is clearly a HUMAN wearing street gear, not a robot or fantasy creature.
Clothes: ash-gray cropped hooded technical jacket with broad sloping shoulders, asymmetrical zipper and one folded collar panel, black fitted base layer, loose graphite cargo trousers tapering at ankle, worn gray high-top combat sneakers, black gloves. One small blank rectangular metal ID plate clipped at belt; no writing. Tiny AMBER status light on a compact wrist terminal, thin cable neatly attached to sleeve, subtle hardware at neck. Restrained monochrome graphite/ash/silver palette with only tiny amber accent. Silhouette dominated by deep hood and featureless dark face opening. Street-level cyberpunk underground challenger, worn seams, utility straps attached to body. No cape, long robe, weapons, floating effects, oversized armor or robot hands.

STYLE: grounded late-1990s 16-bit arcade fighting-game pixel art, visible square clusters, sharp stepped edges, limited shading ramps, dark outlines, serious adult anatomy. No chibi, cartoon mascot, big head, toy gear, smooth vector illustration or painterly blur. Every frame identical body proportions and clothing.

LAYOUT: square PNG with true transparent background. EXACTLY NINE cells, strict 3x3 equal square grid. No labels, text, grid lines, ground, background, cast shadow or checkerboard drawing. At least 7% clear transparent padding inside ALL cell edges. Each figure fully contained in cell, never touching neighboring cells. All full-body frames three-quarter facing RIGHT, same consistent body scale, shared foot baseline, standing height max 80% cell. Portrait fully contained.
TOP TWO ROWS: six CLEAN idle frames forming a subtle loop. Understated patient stance with feet planted apart, elbows low, gloved hands briefly tug and settle the opposite glove cuff at waist, slight shoulder breathing and head tilt. Hood and opaque mask unchanged. No major movement, walking, attacks or glowing face.
BOTTOM LEFT: BATTERED defeat, sits on ground with one knee up, forearm resting on knee, shoulders hunched and head lowered; hood frayed, jacket scuffed, opaque visor surface scratched but NOT broken open. No face revealed, no bandage pasted on mask, no gore.
BOTTOM CENTER: BATTERED victory, stands wearily with one hand pulling hood back into position and other hand holding ribs, head tilted with quiet confidence; same scrapes and frayed clothing, still completely faceless opaque visor. No flex, raised fist or peace sign.
BOTTOM RIGHT: CLEAN close-up portrait, head and shoulders, deep charcoal hood, fully opaque black featureless faceplate, silver rim, gray technical collar and tiny amber neck indicator. No damage. The portrait should feel like a mysterious empty player slot while still visibly belonging to a specific beautifully designed human fighter.
No face in ANY pose. Consistent anonymity and no provider branding.
